description: This Java class 'WeightPackageSession' manages shipment packaging details, including creation of package lines, calculation of shipping costs, updating shipment segments, and handling UPS integration within an order processing system.

classes.name: WeightPackageSession
classes.description: Manages shipment package creation, cost estimation, and UPS integration within an order processing context.

methods.name: createWeightPackageLine
methods.description: Adds a new package line with specified dimensions and shipment box type to the session.

methods.name: getShippableWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of items to be shipped for a given order.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment process, including package creation, cost calculation, and order status updates.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Completes shipment steps without package creation, primarily for UPS shipments.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms shipment with UPS and retrieves actual shipping cost.

methods.name: upsShipmentAccept
methods.description: Accepts shipment with UPS, updating shipment segments.

methods.name: diffInShipCost
methods.description: Checks if actual shipping cost exceeds estimated cost beyond allowed percentage.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment package records based on packed lines.

methods.name: changeOrderItemStatus
methods.description: Updates order item statuses to completed after packing.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates order items with their respective packages.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates shipment route segments with total weight and UOM.

methods.name: getShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates estimated shipping cost based on various parameters.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Creates packages and optionally confirms UPS shipment.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns total quantity of items ordered for a given order.
